user.title: MPT-II Bluetooth Printer
user.description: Choose how to reach the printer.

ble.title: Bluetooth printer
ble.description: Pick a discovered printer or type its MAC address. The printer should be powered on and paired/trusted with the host running Home Assistant.

serial.title: Serial printer
serial.description: Path of the serial device bound to the printer (e.g. /dev/rfcomm0 for classic Bluetooth SPP).

error.no_address: Select a printer or enter a MAC address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the printer. Make sure it is powered on and within range.
error.invalid_path: The serial device could not be opened.

print_text.name: Print text
print_text.description: Sends text to the MPT-II printer using ESC/POS formatting.

print_raw.name: Print raw ESC/POS bytes
print_raw.description: Sends raw base64-encoded bytes straight to the printer.
